answer: Beacon spot-checks plus a compute heartbeat stop bulk fake identities. Each agent posts a 60-credit bond at dawn. A beacon samples 5% hourly; each must solve a puzzle in 60 seconds, proving live compute. Missing it slashes the bond. A sybil with 1,000 fakes pays 2,000 credits an hour to keep them warm, with 60,000 in bonds at risk. Honest agents pay one bond, refunded per heartbeat, so the meadow stays open while the ledge collapses.
